data.title: 因幡巡 · 差一点就夹到了
data.description: 夹娃娃机里的小兔子已经挪到出口旁。巡扶着摇杆，另一只手悬在按钮上，先朝你露出一个“这次肯定行”的笑容。
data.promptProse: At an arcade claw machine, Meguru wears a mint hoodie and denim shorts. One hand holds the joystick and the other hovers over the button; a small rabbit plush lies near the chute behind the glass. She gives the viewer a confident smile under the colored machine lights.
data.animaCaption: Her hands stay outside the glass, one on the joystick and one above its button.
data.action: 握住摇杆，把手停在夹娃娃按钮上
